meta.title: cortex-ia Installer Flows
meta.subtitle: Install, sync, doctor, recover, uninstall/rollback, conflict authorization model and invariants

steps.label: CLI dispatch
steps.description: install | sync | doctor | recover | rollback | uninstall (internal/app/app.go)

steps.label: Options
steps.description: Cortex / Context7 / ApplyTheme / overwrite toggles; each toggle re-plans (internal/install/service.go:Options)

steps.label: Plan
steps.description: PlanInstall / PlanSync derive effects and bind planDigest (internal/pipeline/engine.go:PlanInstall, PlanSync)

steps.label: Review
steps.description: Clearable vs non-clearable conflicts; overwrite authorization; Enter feedback (internal/install/service.go:applyPlanWithConfirmation)

steps.label: Cortex preflight
steps.description: Missing binary -> automatic argv-only go install with GOBIN/GOPATH fallback; failure is a non-fatal warning (internal/install/cortex_check.go:EnsureCortexBinary)

steps.label: Confirm
steps.description: ExpectedPlanDigest binding; drift rejects as PlanDriftError (internal/pipeline/engine.go:checkPlanDrift)

steps.label: Apply
steps.description: Verified backup -> journaled apply -> rollback-on-fail with preimages (internal/pipeline/apply.go:ApplyConfirmed, internal/pipeline/journal.go)

steps.label: Post effects
steps.description: TUI plugin registration + opt-in theme overlay; ThemeOutcome applied | skipped-not-requested | planned | error (internal/install/receipt.go:applyPostPipelineEffects)

steps.label: Overwritable conflict
steps.description: unmanaged-existing / unmanaged-drift: explicit overwrite converts to EffectOverwrite (internal/pipeline/engine.go:ConflictUnmanagedExisting)

steps.label: Manual-only conflict
steps.description: malformed-config / mcp-conflict: overwrite never clears; resolve manually then re-plan (internal/pipeline/engine.go:ConflictMalformedConfig, ConflictMCP)

steps.label: Never auto-deleted
steps.description: stale-drift: stale owned artifact modified after install is never deleted (internal/pipeline/engine.go:ConflictStaleDrift)

steps.label: Doctor (read-only)
steps.description: Inspects state, journals and cortex suggest-only with no mutation (internal/install/doctor.go:Doctor)

steps.label: Recover
steps.description: Journal restore with explicit confirmation; RecoverEffect retries post-effects, reported NotAttempted when skipped (internal/install/rollback.go:Recover, internal/install/service.go:RecoverEffect)

cards.title: Digest binding
cards.description: Confirmation is bound to ExpectedPlanDigest; any drift rejects before backup or write (PlanDriftError, ErrPlanDrift).

cards.title: Non-fatal degrade
cards.description: Cortex binary preflight failure is a warning: install proceeds with degraded optional capability.

cards.title: Opt-in theme
cards.description: The cortex theme overlay is only applied when explicitly requested; default outcome is skipped-not-requested.

cards.title: argv-only exec
cards.description: Cortex install runs an argv list without a shell; no interpolated command strings.

cards.title: Backup / rollback
cards.description: Apply captures a verified backup and journal preimages; failed apply restores from them.

cards.title: Fail-closed ownership
cards.description: Unaccredited or unmanaged content blocks mutation; ownership is proven by recorded evidence, never assumed.
